calculation_provenance.assumptions: All 100-card non-autograph tier-specific numbered base rows with denominator >=20 and serial >1 are calibration anchors. Common, Uncommon and Rare limits are mapped independently. Conditional on selected complete numbered tiers substantially reaching Hobby packs. Median implied packs; maximum spread 5%. Rounded estimates to nearest one. No autograph or 1/1 calibration. Common insert aggregate 2:1 is withheld because FIVE THEMES conflicts with four official checklist themes; their numbered limits only are expanded by theme.

withheld.reason: Source says FIVE THEMES, but official checklist has four common insert themes totaling 100 cards. Aggregate 2:1 is preserved, not applied separately to each theme; production allocation withheld pending reconciliation.
